id: title:Gilbert09:classify read timeouts as retryable not a tracked error

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the classification of GitLab API errors, potentially allowing warehouse ingestion activity to be retried by Temporal when a read timeout occurs, rather than being treated as a non-retryable failure.
review.reason: The observed change adds 'Read timed out' to the set of retryable errors for GitLab API responses.
